Top 3 reasons to choose Dacia Spring 100% electric city car!

So much more than a city car! Spring is equipped with two electric motors, 4 seats, and a 308 L boot to meet all your needs, whether you live in the city or the country.

Dacia Spring 100% electric is easy to charge at home or at public charging points.

Inside this four-seater city car, enjoy advanced features like the 10” multimedia system⁵ with wireless connectivity, designed to make your day to day life easier.

Dacia Spring 100% electric, designed for real life! Versatile city car designed for everyday use, spacious with 4 adult seats, connected, and restyled in a robust, modern design.

### a cleverly designed interior

Thanks to its modular design, the Spring city car offers a generously sized boot. It also features 32.7 litres of cleverly designed, easily accessible storage and four full-sized, comfortable seats for adults.

Driving range and charging

Spring can cover up to 6 days of driving on average in the city. You will also love how easy it is to manage from day to day, whether checking its battery level remotely or charging it from 20% to 80% in under 29 minutes³.

power to object, V2L bidirectional charging

Your car runs on electricity, but why not use some of that power for other things?

  
The “Vehicle to Load” feature lets you power certain household devices using the electricity stored in your car’s battery while you are on the go. Yes, you can now power an electric grill, an external light or even a coffee machine when you are on the go. 

  

\* “Vehicle to load” is standard on the Extreme and Cargo version.   

electric driving with Dacia

connected

## 

connected on every level

multimedia and technology

Real-time traffic, planning charging remotely, or driver-assistance systems and safety systems: discover all of Spring’s multimedia and connected systems.  

Follow all driving and consumption information on a 7-inch screen.

Telephone, radio, GPS navigation, multimedia, and much more. Connect your smartphone via WiFi or USB sockets and access your information with wired or wireless smartphone mirroring.

Streamline your daily commute with real-time traffic updates and the latest European maps.

With the My Dacia app, you can check your battery’s remaining charge or driving range, schedule your charging, or activate the heat or air conditioning a few minutes before getting in your vehicle.

keep driving simple

Dacia Spring with 4 seats is equipped with the latest generation driver-assistance systems¹, designed to enhance your safety and smooth manoeuvring.  

### lane keeping assist

Warns you and corrects your trajectory if you drift from your lane.

### traffic sign recognition

Displays the speed limit and warns you if you are speeding.

### Active emergency braking (AEBS)

Helps prevent front-end collisions and minimises the severity of the accident.
